title: Bipartite graphs are exactly the graphs with no odd cycle
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph. Then $G$ admits a proper vertex $2$-colouring — equivalently, its vertices can be partitioned into two independent sets — if and only if every cycle in $G$ has even length.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
biconditional: 2-colourable iff every cycle has even length
replaced:
\emph{A graph is bipartite if and only if it contains no odd
cycle.}
